title: NativaX conformance run summary
description: Run-level metadata for one conformance execution. Per-test rows are canonical in the JSONL named by resultsFile; this document must not duplicate them. Readers also accept historical summaries that embed a results array (those predate schema 1.0 and lack total).

resultsFile.description: Basename of the sibling JSONL file holding one TestResult per line.

results.description: Legacy only. Current writers omit this field; loaders merge resultsFile instead.
